questions.question: What is the name given to the material manifestation's ultimate particle, which is indivisible and not formed into a body?
questions.explanation: "The material manifestation's ultimate particle, which is indivisible and not formed into a body, is called the atom." (SB 3.11.1)

questions.question: Atoms are the ultimate state of what?
questions.explanation: "Atoms are the ultimate state of the manifest universe." (SB 3.11.2)

questions.question: Time is described as the potency of which Personality of Godhead?
questions.explanation: "Time is the potency of the almighty Personality of Godhead, Hari, who controls all physical movement although He is not visible in the physical world." (SB 3.11.3)

questions.question: The hexatom, the combination of three double atoms, is visible in what?

options.text: The sunshine entering through holes of a window screen

questions.explanation: "This hexatom is visible in the sunshine which enters through the holes of a window screen." (SB 3.11.5)

questions.question: One hundred trutis make one of what unit?
questions.explanation: "The time duration needed for the integration of three trasarenus is called a truti, and one hundred trutis make one vedha." (SB 3.11.6)

questions.question: Fifteen kasthas make one of what unit?
questions.explanation: "...five ksanas combined together make one kastha, and fifteen kasthas make one laghu." (SB 3.11.7)

questions.question: How many dandas (nadikas) make one muhurta?
questions.explanation: "Two dandas make one muhurta..." (SB 3.11.8)

questions.question: How many fortnights are there in a month?
questions.explanation: "...and there are two fortnights, white and black, in a month." (SB 3.11.10)

questions.question: One complete month (two fortnights) is equal to one complete day and night for which planets?
questions.explanation: "The aggregate of two fortnights is one month, and that period is one complete day and night for the Pita planets." (SB 3.11.11)

questions.question: A combination of how many day and night of the demigods forms one complete calendar year for a human being?
questions.explanation: "Two solar movements make one day and night of the demigods, and that combination of day and night is one complete calendar year for the human being." (SB 3.11.12)

questions.question: How often should everyone offer respects to the sun with all ingredients of worship?
questions.explanation: "...and therefore everyone should offer him respects once every five years with all ingredients of worship." (SB 3.11.15)

questions.question: The aggregate number of years of all four millenniums combined is equal to how many thousand years of the demigods?
questions.explanation: "The aggregate number of years of all of these combined is equal to twelve thousand years of the demigods." (SB 3.11.18)

questions.question: The duration of the Satya millennium equals how many years of the demigods?
questions.explanation: "The duration of the Satya millennium equals 4,800 years of the years of the demigods..." (SB 3.11.19)

questions.question: The four yugas multiplied by one thousand comprise one of what for the planet of Brahma?
questions.explanation: "...the four yugas multiplied by one thousand comprise one day on the planet of Brahma." (SB 3.11.22)

questions.question: The three worlds continue to exist during Brahma's day through the life durations of how many consecutive Manus?
questions.explanation: "...and they continue to exist through the life durations of fourteen consecutive Manus, or fathers of mankind." (SB 3.11.23)

questions.question: Each Manu enjoys a life of a little more than how many sets of four millenniums?
questions.explanation: "Each and every Manu enjoys a life of a little more than seventy-one sets of four millenniums." (SB 3.11.24)

questions.question: The devastation at the end of Brahma's day takes place due to fire emanating from the mouth of whom?
questions.explanation: "The devastation takes place due to the fire emanating from the mouth of Sankarsana..." (SB 3.11.30)

questions.question: Which half of Brahma's life is described as currently being in progress?
questions.explanation: "The first half of the duration of Brahma's life is already over, and the second half is now current." (SB 3.11.34)

questions.question: Why is the Varaha millennium so named?

options.text: The Personality of Godhead appeared as the hog incarnation

questions.explanation: "...the Varaha millennium because the Personality of Godhead appeared in that millennium as the hog incarnation." (SB 3.11.37)

questions.question: The duration of the two parts of Brahma's entire life equals what for the Supreme Personality of Godhead?
questions.explanation: "The duration of the two parts of Brahma's life, as above mentioned, is calculated to be equal to one nimesa [less than a second] for the Supreme Personality of Godhead..." (SB 3.11.38)

questions.question: How much thicker is each layer of elements covering the universes than the one before?
questions.explanation: "The layers or elements covering the universes are each ten times thicker than the one before..." (SB 3.11.41)
